title: Ocean Sentinel - Trujillo Part I Oil Spill Corpus
description: Canonical private dataset package for Ocean Sentinel oil-spill segmentation experiments. Contains complete 1,200 Sentinel-1 SAR GeoTIFF image patches (2-channel float32 dB) and 1,200 ground-truth masks (1-channel uint8 binary) from Trujillo-Acatitla et al. (July 2024) Part I (Zenodo DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.8346860), accompanied by the canonical spatial split manifest and SHA-256 integrity manifest.
